title: AI Learning Design and Knowledge Transfer

questions.question: What is the main weakness of generic AI-generated training text?
options: It can create content volume without role transfer or behavior change
It always contains too many tests
It removes the need for practice
questions.explanation: Learning design must target role outcomes and transfer.

questions.question: Which signal is part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Practice need indicates that learners must perform a task, not just read content.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact recommend?
options: The right learning form and controls for an enablement scenario
questions.explanation: The artifact maps learning signals to forms and controls.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: Knowledge checks provide evidence that learning happened.

questions.question: When is a workshop a better fit than a micro lesson?
options: When learners need guided practice, discussion, and role-specific transfer
When the topic has no audience
When completion evidence must be avoided
questions.explanation: Workshops are useful when practice and discussion matter.

questions.question: What should AI learning design start with?
options: Role outcome, target behavior, practice task, and transfer evidence
A list of tools without context
questions.explanation: Transfer-focused design keeps AI-generated training useful.
